policy.domain_region: A curated service market and routing-use classification, independent of Geo/IP location. It is not a guarantee that every global product of a company has a single country.
policy.missing_evidence: Absence from another catalogue is unknown, not an opposing vote.
policy.shortcut_exclusions: Skip only the tld-ru include subtree, then reject the exact registration-wide ru.com/ru.net suffix predicates. Do not delete named rules merely because they use a .ru or .su suffix.
policy.advertising: Explicit @ads/@telemetry-only rows are not separately admitted; an accepted service parent may still contain such children, since no NOT subtraction is fabricated.
policy.source_conflicts: The selected source itself marks My.Games as having left the Russian market and VK Cloud KZ as a Kazakhstan venture. Their six roots are deferred for current-market classification, not labelled proven malicious or universally false.
policy.shared_infrastructure: A whole generic cloud root is not a Russian-service identity. An explicitly classified exact connection endpoint may be retained without promoting the root.
policy.positive_conflicts: Explicit configured market exceptions preserve meaningful RU children even if a CN parent contains them. The overlap is reported as unresolved, and neither rule implies a routing action or precedence.
policy.supplements: Purpose-scoped mature community lists are primary inputs. Missing from an identity catalogue is not a rejection criterion. No per-rule identity proof, scores or votes.

cn_market_overlaps.reason: DLC explicitly includes this Russian-bank-market endpoint, while the CN list contains broader ccb.com. Both positive predicates are useful but ordinary .list cannot subtract the child from the CN parent; report an unresolved positive overlap without an implicit priority.

exception_notes.gov.cn and edu.cn: Retain these mature named institutional namespaces as mainland government/education routing scope; this is not a whole .cn shortcut or a server-location claim.
exception_notes.shared_roots: Only whole shared hosting suffixes are excluded; named/exact endpoints keep their original scope.
exception_notes.dotless_suffixes: Generic and branded TLD shortcuts are reported separately and not automatically promoted to regional membership.

decisions.reason: Country/registration shortcuts do not establish individual service market or ownership. ru.com and ru.net are Public Suffix List registration boundaries.
Source comments themselves identify a market-exit or foreign-market context. Keep the reason visible; do not infer geography from the company origin.

This is not the generic .ru shortcut. IANA identifies a Yandex-managed branded TLD, but the current producer conservatively rejects all dotless identity suffixes. Report this distinct scope instead of calling it a generic country TLD or pretending it was retained.
